snippet.title: Housekeeper: Anomaly // Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818750/Housekeeper_Anomaly

Scavenge abandoned apartments, cut on broken glass, fight anomalies, trade with the merchants, deceive them into buying bad products and most importantly - try to stay alive and care about yourself!

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Alex Grim
📚 Publisher: Alex Grim
📅 Release Date: Aug 31, 2026
🎯 Genre: Action, Adventure, Indie

The developers describe the content like this:
May contain mildly violent scenes, occasional swearing, drug usage
